For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
May the Lord give ear to you in the day of trouble; may you be placed on high by the name of the God of Jacob;
（大衛的詩，交與伶長。）願耶和華在你遭難的日子應允你；願名為雅各神的高舉你。
May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
May he send you help from the holy place, and give you strength from Zion;
願他從聖所救助你，從錫安堅固你，
May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
May he keep all your offerings in mind, and be pleased with the fat of your burned offerings; (Selah.)
記念你的一切供獻，悅納你的燔祭，（細拉）
May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
May he give you your heart's desire, and put all your purposes into effect.
將你心所願的賜給你，成就你的一切籌算。
May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
We will be glad in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will put up our flags: may the Lord give you all your requests.
我們要因你的救恩誇勝，要奉我們神的名豎立旌旗。願耶和華成就你一切所求的！
Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
Now am I certain that the Lord gives salvation to his king; he will give him an answer from his holy heaven with the strength of salvation in his right hand.
現在我知道耶和華救護他的受膏者，必從他的聖天上應允他，用右手的能力救護他。
Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
Some put their faith in carriages and some in horses; but we will be strong in the name of the Lord our God.
有人靠車，有人靠馬，但我們要提到耶和華─我們神的名。
They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
They are bent down and made low; but we have been lifted up.
他們都屈身仆倒，我們卻起來，立得正直。
O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
Come to our help, Lord: let the king give ear to our cry.
求耶和華施行拯救；我們呼求的時候，願王應允我們！
